claims.text: The hotel is set on a crescent bay in Grand Cul-de-Sac, St. Barts, in a beachfront location.

findings.quote: Set on a perfect crescent bay, our hotel in St Barts is refined and fresh, as elegant and restorative as its stunning beachfront location.
Unique elegance in Grand Cul-de-Sac.

claims.text: The interiors are by designer Sybille de Margerie.

findings.quote: With interiors by celebrated designer Sybille de Margerie

claims.text: Invisible drop-down screens turn the outdoor terraces into private, shady enclaves without blocking the view.

findings.quote: Invisible drop-down screens easily transform outdoor terraces into private enclaves, shady and comfortable but without disturbing the view.

claims.text: Rooms have in-room amenities by Diptyque.

findings.quote: the thoughtful integration of technology and in-room amenities by Diptyque

claims.text: Le Barth Ocean Jacuzzi rooms have a spacious terrace with a private jacuzzi.

findings.quote: Enjoy special moments in our Le Barth Océan Jacuzzi room, the perfect romantic setting with a spacious terrace with a private jacuzzi to relax and unwind.

claims.text: Some Junior Suite Ocean rooms can be connected to create a large two-bedroom suite for families.

findings.quote: Le Barthélemy offers the option to connect to some Junior Suite Océan rooms, to create a large, two-bedroom suite, perfect for luxury family vacations.

claims.text: The hotel has a serviced beach in Grand Cul de Sac with lounge chairs.

findings.quote: Our serviced beach in Grand Cul de Sac with comfortable lounge chairs

claims.text: Le B. Spa has an open-air atrium that brings the outdoors in.

findings.quote: beginning with its soothing Caribbean setting and open-air atrium that invites the outdoors in

claims.text: The spa has a hammam.

findings.quote: the hammam helps to purify and cleanse the skin

claims.text: The Longevity Experience is led by Longevity Doctor Franck Baudino and his team, with a personalized health assessment and tailored protocol.

findings.quote: Our Longevity Doctor, Franck Baudino, and his team of experts, conduct an ultra-personalized health assessment and create a tailored protocol

claims.text: There is a fully equipped fitness center and group yoga classes.

findings.quote: Energize yourself at our fully equipped, state-of-the-art fitness center or take one of our purifying group yoga classes

claims.text: Amis St. Barth is a seaside French beach restaurant serving lunch daily and brunch on Sundays.

findings.quote: Consider the relaxed seaside setting of Amis St. Barth, where the casual elegance of a French beach restaurant is the perfect backdrop
Offering lunch daily and now brunch on Sundays

claims.text: Activities at the hotel's Water Sport house on Grand Cul-de-Sac Bay are included in the stay, with stand-up paddle boards, canoes and snorkeling equipment.

findings.quote: The Grand Cul-de-Sac Bay is the ideal place to relax and enjoy activities included in your stay at our Water Sport house. Relax and explore on a Stand-Up paddle board. Stroll on the water with our canoes for adventure.
Discover the corals, turtles and fishes with our snorkeling equipment.

claims.text: La Suite Ocean Piscine Privee has a sprawling patio with a heated plunge pool.

findings.quote: from your own private enclave with a sprawling patio and heated plunge pool. Unwind in the blissful comfort of a king-sized bed in the La Suite Océan Piscine Privée.

claims.text: The spa is Le B. Spa by Augustinus Bader, and its Vitality Pools are three tubs: one warm tub and two cold tubs.

findings.quote: Le B. Spa by Augustinus Bader
Our Vitality Pools are composed of 3 tubs : 1 warm tub at 100 °F and two cold tubs of 52°F and 41°F

claims.text: Le Duplex Ocean Plage spans two floors and is a private beachfront retreat a few steps from the beach.

findings.quote: The ravishing accommodation spanning throughout two floors, reserves a private beachfront retreat at the #1 Resort in the Caribbean, just a few steps away from the sunny beach.
at the spacious Le Duplex Océan Plage

claims.text: Grand Cul de Sac is a favorite beach for families thanks to its calm waves and smooth, shallow waters.

findings.quote: Grand Cul de Sac is one of the favorite beaches for families thanks to its calm waves and smooth, shallow waters

claims.text: Grand Cul de Sac beach is in the northeast of St Barts, 3 miles (about 5 km) from Gustavia and a short drive from the island's airport.

findings.quote: Located northeast of St Barts, this quiet beach is 3 miles (ca. 5 km) from Gustavia, a short drive from the island's airport.

claims.text: St Barthelemy is reached by plane or via direct links from neighboring islands; the hotel's Guest Experience Makers can help with internal flights.

findings.quote: Easily accessible by plane or via direct links from neighboring islands
our GEMs (Guest Experience Makers) are happy to assist with internal flights to St. Barthélemy.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects St. Barth's exclusivity.
